# EMOTIV

> EMOTIV provides wireless EEG headsets and brain-computer interface technology for cognitive monitoring, neuromarketing research, and accessibility applications.

EMOTIV specializes in consumer-grade and research-grade EEG devices including the MN8, MW20, Insight, and Flex 2 systems. The company offers the Cortex API for BCI application development, EmotivPRO software for data analysis, and solutions spanning mental wellness, neuromarketing, academic research, and product innovation.

## Key Topics

- EEG (Electroencephalography)
- Brain-Computer Interface (BCI)
- Wireless EEG Headsets
- Neuromarketing
- MN8
- MW20
- Insight
- Flex 2
- Cortex API
- EmotivPRO
- Brain Data Analysis
- Cognitive Tracking

- Consumer Research
- Mental Wellness

## EEG Hardware & Devices

- [MN8 – 2 Channel EEG Headphones](https://www.emotiv.com/mn8): MN8 2-channel EEG headphones product page for brain monitoring and cognitive tracking
- [Emotiv MW20 | EEG Neuro Earphones for Brain Activity Tracking](https://www.emotiv.com/mw20): MW20 EEG-enabled wireless earphones for real-time brain activity and focus tracking
- [Emotiv Insight: 5-Channel Wireless EEG Headset for BCI & Research](https://www.emotiv.com/insight): Emotiv Insight 5-channel portable EEG headset for BCI research and cognitive tracking
- [Flex 2 - 32 Channel Wireless EEG Head Cap System](https://www.emotiv.com/flex-2): Flex 2 32-channel wireless EEG system for research-grade brain monitoring
- [X-Trodes EEG Patches | Wireless Brain Monitoring by EMOTIV](https://www.emotiv.com/x-trodes): X-Trodes wireless EEG patches for non-invasive brain monitoring with EmotivPRO

## Core Applications & Solutions

- [Emotiv App | EEG Brain Monitoring & Cognitive Tracking](https://www.emotiv.com/emotiv-app): Emotiv App for real-time brain activity, focus, stress tracking with MN8 and MW20 devices
- [Emotiv - Brain Computer Interface](https://www.emotiv.com/brain-computer-interface): EMOTIV non-invasive BCI technology for device control and accessibility solutions
- [Neuromarketing](https://www.emotiv.com/pages/neuromarketing): Emotiv neuromarketing solutions for brain data analysis and consumer insights research
- [Neuromarketing in Consumer Research using EEG headsets](https://www.emotiv.com/pages/consumer-research): Neuromarketing research using EMOTIV EEG headsets for consumer brain activity studies
- [Consumer EEG Headsets for Product Innovation](https://www.emotiv.com/pages/innovation): EMOTIV EEG solutions for product innovation and consumer behavior understanding
